title: DeepSeek History: From High-Flyer to V4.1 Flash (2026)
summary: DeepSeek history from 2023 to 2026: Liang Wenfeng and High-Flyer, the R1 shock that hit Nvidia, MIT-licensed open weights, V4 Pro, V4.1 Flash, and funding.
body_markdown:
The TSK-1 Benchmark sends the same app request to each model family inside Taskade Genesis and records whether the finished app works, saves data, and survives follow-up edits. The DeepSeek results page summarizes the family as best for polished apps with rich workspace data, and it keeps a dated, test-by-test record, including the builds that failed.
